title: Hearty Gooey Ethiopian Turkey Neck Stew
description: A rich and flavorful one-pot Ethiopian dish featuring turkey neck, with a unique tempering-chocolate twist, perfect for a cold winter night, and is egg-free friendly.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey neck and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Stir the melted chocolate into the stew and continue to simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
